name: riemann-map
description: Research-grade Riemann-map / conformal-mapping studio. A new suite app (separate app per CLAUDE.md decision 8) built on the shared @cas/* packages: custom φ via @cas/expr, the numerical region map 𝔻 → Ω via @cas/conformal (lightning + forward-map builder), figure export via @cas/export, and map hand-off + permalinks via @cas/interchange (it imports another tool's conformal map rather than computing dynamics itself). Renders pure-2D — the source region and its conformal image in linked canvas panes.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
